_comment: Device attestation policy, compiled into the companion (src/attest/policy.rs, include_str!).
See vault-os/docs/device-attestation.md. Hex SHA-256 values, lowercase, no separators.
releaseSignerSha256: SHA-256 of the Phone Vault RELEASE APK signing certificate (DER). Empty until the release key exists: no phone can be GENUINE before then.
developmentSignerSha256: SHA-256 of the development (appliance) signing certificate. Accepted ONLY when the user turns on Developer mode, and then never better than DEVELOPMENT.

avbKeySha256: SHA-256 of the AVB public key flashed with `fastboot flash avb_custom_key` (avbtool extract_public_key output), as reported in rootOfTrust.verifiedBootKey. Empty until the release AVB key exists.
minOsPatchLevel: oldest accepted osPatchLevel (YYYYMM) for a locked, otherwise genuine device.
